verdicts.name: ALimitedSound::scalar_deleting_destructor
verdicts.why: Calls 0x4de50 (ALimitedSound::~ALimitedSound), then ABaseSound::operator_delete(this,0x120) if flag&1. Same shape as PS2 ~ALimitedSound's deleting path (delete size 0x120).

verdicts.name: ALimitedSound::~ALimitedSound
verdicts.why: Sets the vtable 0x18c8c8, decrements the instance counter DAT_00243b30, then calls the AOneShotSound dtor. PS2 does the same: DAT_00355ec0--, vtable ALimitedSound -> AOneShotSound. The same vtable and counter++ are inlined in ESpawnExplosion's 'ExplosionBass' sound, as PS2 inlines ALimitedSound there.

intermediates.name: AOneShotSound::~AOneShotSound
intermediates.why: Called by ALimitedSound::~ALimitedSound (0x4de50) as the base dtor. Sets vtable 0x18c840, destroys the 3 AVoice::View array (stride 0x1c), then ~ABaseSound. Same as PS2 ~AOneShotSound without the delete flag.

verdicts.why: STL list<T>::_Incsize ('list<T> too long'): MSVC STL helper.
STL list push_back (_Buynode 0x800f0 + _Incsize) inlined from CreatePathHandle: MSVC STL helper.

verdicts.name: RLightning::Bolt::~Bolt
verdicts.why: ClearAllBolts calls it before delete, in the same position as PS2's ~Bolt. Body frees the array member at +8 (0x9f870, new[] with count, element size 0x18), then the new[] array at +0 and zeroes +0/+4, like PS2 ~Bolt without the delete flag.

verdicts.name: RLightning::BeginBoltDraw
verdicts.why: Bolt::Draw calls it after the CalcWorldPos loop, where PS2 calls BeginBoltDraw. Body: stores the float at +0x6e0 (PS2 +0x710), allocates the 0xe000 buffer and zeroes the 0x800 dwords at +0xc000, then takes the flag at +0x6c8 (PS2 +0x6f8) into the JitterStripPoints branches. Identical, offsets -0x30.
vector<T*>::reserve (FastAlloc 'STL', length check 0x40000000): MSVC STL helper.
_Tree::insert (lower-bound walk, _Insert): MSVC STL helper.
STL heap helper (_Push_heap with a predicate): MSVC STL.
STL heap/sort helper (_Adjust_heap-style on 8-byte elements): MSVC STL.
vector size() for 0x4c-byte elements: generic STL helper; PS2 has no counterpart.

Sound-object helper called from WWorld::Open: frees the old AVoice at +0x13c and allocates a new one from sample id >>7 / &0x7f. PS2 inlines this whole body in WWorld::Open (FastAlloc(100,'AVoice')), so there is no PS2 function to name.

verdicts.name: EAGL::GeoPrimState::GetPrimitiveType
verdicts.why: Sits right after SetPrimitiveType on both platforms. Getter of the field SetPrimitiveType writes (+0): *out = this->type; return 1. The PS2 signature is the same (this, int* out) returning 1; PS2 decodes a packed bitfield instead.
Sets the byte at +8 and returns 1. PS2 has no such GeoPrimState setter (PS2 GeoPrimState keeps only Set/GetPrimitiveType and Set/GetDepthTestMethod), so there is no name to give.
Tree/list teardown (erase all, FastFree head 0x98) called from an unwind/atexit thunk: MSVC STL helper.
Tree clear (recursive erase 0x12ef80, reset head links) called from an atexit thunk: MSVC STL helper.
STREAM static (buffer-fill completion check). The PS2 counterparts in STREAM.c are unnamed FUN_ statics (0x3050e8..0x305630), so there is no name.
STREAM static (request pump: FILESYS_read/MEM_copy). The PS2 counterpart is an unnamed FUN_ static, so there is no name.

verdicts.name: ActPoser::GetRootBonePosOri
verdicts.why: Called by ActActor::Update as on PS2. It copies the 64-byte matrix from (this+0x24)->+0x100 at index (this+4)->+0x18. PS2 does the same with this+0x28 and this+8, the same +0x100 and +0x18 (object offsets -4).

verdicts.name: ActPoser::GetWeaponBonePosOri
verdicts.why: Called by ActActor::Update. It copies the 64-byte matrix at index (this+4)->+0x1c+i*4 into out. Identical to PS2 (this+8 ->+0x1c+i*4, same +0x100 table).

verdicts.name: ActSkeleton::GetStillPose
verdicts.why: DoMainPose calls it first, like PS2. Body: FUN_fa340(this+8 as ECX, this+0xc, 0), matching PS2 FUN_262aa8(this+8, this+0xc, 0). This is the no-argument overload.

verdicts.name: ActSkeleton::GetStillPose
verdicts.why: The overload with a pose argument: FUN_fa340(this+8, arg, 0), matching PS2 GetStillPose(pose*) -> FUN_262aa8(this+8, arg, 0). DoMainPose calls it twice on both platforms. Genuine PS2 overload.

verdicts.name: AIGroundVehicle::GetTargetPos
verdicts.why: Called by ~EFireWeapon on both platforms. Returns target ? AIVehicle::GetPosition(target) : this+0x17c; PS2 does the same with +0x1a4/+0x1a8 (shift -0x2c).

verdicts.name: AIGroundVehicle::UpdateNavPos
verdicts.why: Called by DoMoveMode as on PS2. Same body: the rigid-body distance check, the +0xb1/+0xb2 direction branches with v4sub/unit, WRoadNav::IncNavPosition, the WRoadNetwork segment flag 0x4000 (byte +0x51 &0x40) -> tangent eval.

verdicts.name: AIGroundVehicle::EngageSplinePath
verdicts.why: Vtable slot 0x18b8e0, next to Disengage. Sets the two flags, physics vcall(1) then vcall(), mode=3 (+0x80, PS2 +0x70), SetSplinePath(arg). Identical sequence to PS2.

verdicts.name: AIGroundVehicle::DisengageSplinePath
verdicts.why: Vtable slot 0x18b8e4. Physics vcall(0), vcall(), mode=1; the inlined SetAttackMode(1) and SetNavigateMode(1) (+0x94, +0x88, SetSplinePath(0)); target +0x178=0 (PS2 +0x1a4, the same -0x2c shift as GetTargetPos); SetSplinePath(0). Same as PS2.

verdicts.name: InputDevice::InputDevice
verdicts.why: XBoxPadDevice ctor calls it where PS2PadDevice calls InputDevice::InputDevice. It sets the vptr to 0x18d9fc (slot 0 = InputDevice::scalar_deleting_destructor 0x50eb0) and stores the int arg (PS2 stores it at +0x14 with the vptr at +0x18).

verdicts.name: InputDevice::~InputDevice
verdicts.why: Called by the XBoxPadDevice dtor (0x51d80) as PS2's ~PS2PadDevice calls ~InputDevice. It only resets the vptr to InputDevice's vtable; this is the non-deleting part of PS2 ~InputDevice.
Generic float clamp(v,lo,hi) used by LoadFile. PS2 has no named counterpart (inlined, or the unlisted static FUN_001a49b0 inside the ~RCameraIniLoader row extent).
Substring-token match helper = PS2 FUN_001a6c68, which lies inside the extent of sheet row 2971 (RCameraIniLoader::LoadFile, size 0x2a70). It is an unlisted static with no name.
